config.language.name: Language
config.language.description: Language used for this mod's tooltips and settings. 'Auto' follows the game. Drop a file in the Locales folder next to the DLL to add one; the game's own codes are used, so German is 'ge' and not 'de'. Takes effect after a restart.
config.note.name: Refresh Required
config.note.description: Changes don't apply immediately. To see updates: leave your current menu (e.g. stash), go to main menu, then return.
config.hideout.showCheckmarks.name: Show Hideout Checkmarks
config.hideout.showCheckmarks.descriptio: Show checkmark and tooltip for hideout areas this item is needed for. When disabled, no hideout checkmark or 'Needed for area' tooltip section is shown.
config.hideout.fulfilledAnyCanBeUpgraded: When TRUE, shows fulfilled checkmark when AT LEAST ONE hideout module can be upgraded. When FALSE, shows fulfilled only when ALL modules can be upgraded.
config.hideout.showFutureModuleLevels.de: Show requirements for future hideout module levels instead of only the next one.
config.hideout.onlyShowCheckmarkOnFir.na: Only Show Hideout Checkmark On FIR Items
config.hideout.onlyShowCheckmarkOnFir.de: When enabled, hideout requirements only drive the checkmark for items that are Found In Raid (FIR). Non-FIR items will not get a checkmark from hideout needs (though quests, wishlist, barters, or crafts can still show one). The 'Needed for area' tooltip lines are still shown.
config.quests.showCheckmarks.name: Show Quest Checkmarks
config.quests.showCheckmarks.description: Show checkmark and tooltip for quests this item is needed for. When disabled, no quest checkmark or quest tooltip section is shown.
config.quests.includeFuture.name: Include Future Quests
config.quests.includeFuture.description: Consider future quests when checking which quests an item is required for. If false, behaves like vanilla.
config.quests.showPrerequisiteCount.name: Show Prerequisite Count
config.quests.showPrerequisiteCount.desc: Show the number of prerequisite quests needed before each quest becomes available. Quests are sorted by prerequisite count with color coding: Green (0 prereqs), Yellow (1-9), Gray (10+).
config.quests.showCheckmarksNonFir.name: Show Quest Checkmarks for Non-FIR Items
config.quests.showCheckmarksNonFir.descr: When enabled, quest checkmarks will appear on items even if they aren't found in raid. Useful if your SPT is configured to accept non-FIR items for quest turn-ins.
config.quests.onlyFirRequired.name: Only Show FiR-Required Quests
config.quests.onlyFirRequired.descriptio: When enabled, quest checkmarks only appear for quests that REQUIRE the item to be Found-in-Raid. Quests that accept non-FiR items (e.g. Ragman's Hot Delivery) won't show a checkmark. This is about whether the QUEST requires FiR; it is separate from 'Show Quest Checkmarks for Non-FIR Items', which is about whether YOUR stored item is FiR.
config.barterCraft.showBarter.name: Show Barter
config.barterCraft.showBarter.descriptio: Show checkmark and tooltip for barters/trades this item is needed for.
config.barterCraft.showCraft.name: Show Craft
config.barterCraft.showCraft.description: Show checkmark and tooltip for crafting recipes this item is needed for.
config.barterCraft.showFutureCraft.name: Show Future Craft
config.barterCraft.showFutureCraft.descr: Show crafting recipes that are not yet unlocked.
config.priority.quest.name: Quest Priority
config.priority.quest.description: Priority for quest checkmarks. Higher number = higher priority when item is needed for multiple things.
config.priority.hideout.name: Hideout Priority
config.priority.hideout.description: Priority for hideout checkmarks. Higher number = higher priority.
config.priority.wishlist.name: Wishlist Priority
config.priority.wishlist.description: Priority for wishlist checkmarks. Higher number = higher priority.
config.priority.barter.name: Barter Priority
config.priority.barter.description: Priority for barter checkmarks. Higher number = higher priority.
config.priority.craft.name: Craft Priority
config.priority.craft.description: Priority for craft checkmarks. Higher number = higher priority.
config.colors.needMore.name: Need More Color
config.colors.needMore.description: Color for items where you need more (default: light red)
config.colors.fulfilled.name: Fulfilled Color
config.colors.fulfilled.description: Color for items where requirement is fulfilled (default: light green)
config.colors.wishlist.name: Wishlist Color
config.colors.wishlist.description: Color for wishlist items (default: light blue)
config.colors.barter.name: Barter Color
config.colors.craft.name: Craft Color
